mapper.select: select (select count(*) from tbl_member where enabled = 'Y') as member_count, (select nvl(sum(price), 0) from tbl_trade where status != 'CANCELED') as total_amount, (select count(*) from tbl_trade where status != 'CANCELED' and regdate >= trunc(sysdate, 'MM')) as month_trade_count, (select count(*) from tbl_member where regdate >= trunc(sysdate, 'MM')) as month_signup_count from dual

select nvl(p.category_seq, c.category_seq) as category_seq, nvl(p.name, c.name) as category_name, count(*) as trade_count, round(avg(t.price)) as avg_price, nvl(sum(case when t.status = 'CONFIRMED' then t.price end), 0) as sales_amount from tbl_trade t inner join tbl_request r on r.request_seq = t.request_seq inner join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = r.category_seq left join tbl_category p on p.category_seq = c.parent_seq where t.status != 'CANCELED' group by nvl(p.category_seq, c.category_seq), nvl(p.name, c.name) order by trade_count desc

select to_char(regdate, 'YYYY-MM') as stat_month, count(*) as cnt, sum(price) as amount from tbl_trade where status != 'CANCELED' and regdate >= add_months(trunc(sysdate, 'MM'), -(#{months} - 1)) group by to_char(regdate, 'YYYY-MM') order by stat_month
